title: Chapter 5: 0.88G Calibration, Water Scans & The Purple Sea (Stardate 49602.1)
summary: As their second 48-hour orbit on Caelum-IV begins, the family experiences the physical effects of 0.88G gravity on their bodies, runs scientific assays to prove the glowing Lantern-Berries and violet ocean are 100% non-toxic, and goes swimming together in the warm purple bay with the effortless closeness forged since Ryan's 1990 hospital discharge.
